nsfwimagemoderation-upload-rejected: Error shown when an image upload is blocked by the moderation classifier.
nsfwimagemoderation-upload-rejected-debu: Debug error shown when an image upload is blocked. $1 is classifier detail (label, scores, threshold).
nsfwimagemoderation-upload-unavailable: Error shown when the moderation classifier cannot be reached and the upload is rejected.
nsfwimagemoderation-upload-unavailable-d: Debug error shown when classification fails. $1 is the failure reason.
nsfwimagemoderation-debug-approved: Notice shown on the next page after a successful image upload when debug mode is enabled. $1 is classifier detail (label, scores, threshold).
